label: Consultant site: one new page, one suffixed collision, one reused existing page
instruction: I am an independent operations consultant. I already have a contact page I am happy with and an old about page. Build me a home page, a better about page, and keep using the contact page I have.

response.summary: A three page site for an independent operations consultant, adding a new about page alongside the existing one and reusing the contact page already published.

content.headline: Fix The Process, Then Hire
content.body: I help companies of fifty to five hundred people find the three operational bottlenecks costing them the most, and fix them before adding headcount.

content.headline: Evidence Before Opinion
content.body: The first two weeks are measurement only. I sit with the people doing the work, time what actually happens, and write down where the queue forms. No recommendations until then.
content.bodySecondary: Most engagements end with fewer changes than the client expected, because three well chosen ones usually clear the bottleneck and a long list never survives contact with a busy team.

content.headline: Start with a conversation
content.body: A first call is free and usually enough to tell whether an engagement makes sense. If it does not, I will say so.

content.headline: Priya Raman
content.body: Nine years independent, after eleven running operations inside manufacturing and logistics businesses. I work alone, on one engagement at a time, which keeps the advice specific.
content.bodySecondary: Clients are usually between fifty and five hundred people: past the stage where somebody can hold the whole process in their head, and before the stage where a consultancy would sell them a transformation programme.

content.headline: Enquiries and availability
content.body: I take on roughly six engagements a year and book two to three months ahead. Email with a rough shape of the problem and when you would want to start.
